title: TextEDA IR v0.14 — common definitions
description: Scalars, identity patterns and unit conventions shared by all shards. The field-name suffix is the unit: _nm nanometers, _mdeg millidegrees, _mohm milliohms, _uv microvolts, _na nanoamps, _uw microwatts, _mhz millihertz, _mdegc millidegrees Celsius, _ppm parts per million, _uohm microohms, _ff femtofarads, _ph picohenries. Rules: docs/adr/ir/0105-ir-shards-and-hashes.md.

device_ref.description: Device id, bare: every device the project reads lives in assets/components/ under its own id. A qualified `<lib>:<id>` is rejected — an external library is a template that was copied in (ADR-0133), not a namespace that is resolved.

format_version.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard, in canonical form (the patch component is left out when it is zero); see teda.md §13.

instance_id.description: Instance id of the board's flat list: U1. An instance of a module carries the module's prefix: <module_instance_id>.<refdes> (M1.U1). This is the identity key; see ADR-0105 decision 6 and ADR-0112 decision 2.

layer_name.description: Layer name, e.g. F.Cu, F.Mask, B.SilkS. A through-hole pad sits on every copper layer: `*.Cu` and `*.Mask` (the wildcard is part of the name, ADR-0129).

lib_id.description: Library name: the directory under assets/symbols/ or assets/footprints/ that holds the file; underscores allowed, e.g. project.

net_id.description: The net name is the identity key: GND, VFB. A net of a module carries the module's prefix: <module_instance_id>.<net> (M1.VFB).

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute (ADR-0104 rule 8).

pad_ref.description: Pad reference in pcb, same shape as pin_ref; the pad number comes from the footprint.

name.description: Parameter name, matching the column name declared in the component's params section.

value.description: The unit is determined by the type declared in the component's params section (resistance→µΩ etc.; see ADR-0105 decision 7).

name.description: Parameter name, matching the column name declared in the component's params section.

text.description: Non-numeric value of a parameter, e.g. a part description.

provenance.description: Where a device's facts came from and whether a human checked them (ADR-0133 decision 5). Omitted means the file makes no claim.

status.description: `generated`: transcribed from a datasheet or a library template, not checked by a human. `reviewed`: a human compared the facts with the datasheet.

verified_by.description: Who checked it (a name or an account). Required when `status` is `reviewed`: a claim nobody can be asked about is worse than no claim.

verified_on.description: The day the check was made (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when `status` is `reviewed`.

refdes.description: Reference designator, e.g. U1, R10; unique within the board-level namespace.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal form of a SHA-256 digest.

slug.description: Shape of component_id / board_id / view page_id / system_id / variant id.

source_ref.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

file.description: Source-file path relative to the project root, e.g. design/sch/charger-buck.teda. Never an absolute path.

line.description: Line number of this object in the source file, 1-based.
